description: This source file defines the UserCreatedShelfRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide data access methods for UserCreatedShelf entities. It includes custom queries and method signatures for retrieving user-created shelves based on various criteria, utilizing Spring Data JPA features like @EntityGraph and @Query.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for UserCreatedShelf entities, includes custom query methods and entity graph configurations to manage user-shelf data.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves associated with a specific user, including their books.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a specific shelf by name for a given user, including its books.

methods.name: findByShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves with a specific name.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a shelf by its unique ID, including its books.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a shelf with the given name exists, case-insensitive and trimmed.
